full_prompt_en: A square aerial landscape photograph looks almost straight down across mountainside terraces, patchwork fields, and a winding road in a remote valley. Broad ocher and rust-colored slopes fill the upper left and upper center, cut into irregular agricultural plots in muted green and gold. A narrow pale road snakes from the upper middle toward the lower left, passing a line of dark trees that follows the valley fold. Across the lower half, terraces curve in tightly stacked bands like contour lines, alternating deep blue-green water, olive vegetation, and warm brown earth. The most saturated turquoise and cobalt areas occupy the lower left, while pale yellow-green strips rise toward the lower right. A small cluster of trees forms a dark knot near the center, separating two distinct systems of curved fields. The high viewpoint compresses height into pattern, yet the shadows along the terrace edges reveal the steep terrain. There are no identifiable people or readable signs; the landscape itself is the whole subject. Warm low sunlight from the upper left grazes ridge tops and dry fields, while lower channels hold cool blue shadow. Fine differences in crop texture, wet soil, and embankment lines make the patterned surface feel physical rather than graphic. Curving natural landforms and more angular rectangular plots meet without a clean boundary. The overall composition turns worked terrain into a dense flowing mosaic of color, contour, and altitude.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形航拍风景照片几乎垂直俯视偏远山谷中的山坡梯田、拼布田块和一条蜿蜒道路。宽阔赭黄与锈色坡面填满左上和上方中央，被切成不规则的柔绿与金色农田。狭窄浅色道路从上方中部蜿蜒至左下，经过一排沿山谷褶皱延伸的深色树木。下半部梯田像等高线一样弯成紧密层叠的色带，深蓝绿水面、橄榄色植被和暖棕土壤交替。最饱和的青蓝与钴蓝区域占据左下，浅黄绿色细带向右下升起。中央附近一簇树形成深色结点，分开两套不同方向的弯曲田地。高视点把高度压成图案，但梯田边缘的阴影仍揭示地势陡峭。没有可辨人物或可读标牌；土地本身就是全部主体。暖而低的阳光从左上方掠过山脊顶和干燥田块，较低的沟渠保留冷蓝阴影。作物肌理、湿土和田埂线的细微差异使纹样表面具有实体感，而非纯图形。弯曲自然地形和更方正的矩形田块相遇，却没有干净分界。整体构图把耕作地貌化为色彩、等高线和海拔高度组成的密集流动镶嵌。
style_prompt_en: The image has an aerial landscape-photography finish, turning real topography into dense abstract pattern. Ocher, rust, olive, jade, turquoise, and cobalt follow uneven bands with sharp boundaries and subtle internal texture. A very high viewpoint flattens perspective, while tiny shadows at the edges of each contour restore the sense of height. Curved nested lines flow past more angular color patches, and dark clustered accents punctuate the broader field. Warm grazing sunlight brings out raised areas, with cool recessed zones deepening the rhythm. The entire frame is filled, yet changes in line spacing give the eye alternating dense and open passages. The overall effect is vivid, geological, and intricately ordered.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有航拍风景摄影质感，把真实地形转化为密集抽象纹样。赭黄、锈色、橄榄、玉绿、青蓝与钴蓝沿不均匀色带延伸，边界清楚，内部肌理细微。极高视点压平透视，每道轮廓边缘的小阴影却恢复高度感。套叠曲线绕过较有棱角的色斑，深色聚块在宽阔色域里形成标点。低角度暖日光显出凸起区域，冷色凹处加深节奏。整幅画面被填满，但线条间距变化给予目光时而密集、时而开阔的通路。整体效果鲜明、富地质感且秩序繁密。
theme_en: Aerial view of terraced fields and a winding valley road
theme_zh: 梯田与蜿蜒山谷道路的俯瞰图
name: Yann Arthus-Bertrand
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
